content: Hence, the overall process for ALOHA works as follows. First, given a set of characters, determine the character space using the CSM. Next, given a specific target character, determine the positive community and negative set of associated characters using the CCM. Lastly, using the positive community and negative set determined above along with a dialogue dataset, recover the language style of the target.
